vcu_g_0159_20001fc2.name: gpio_pa11_pulse_step
vcu_g_0159_20001fc2.description: Step counter of a six-call pulse on PA11, advanced by vcu_pa11_pulse_step. It stays 0 while idle. While the armed flag at 0x20001FC0 (set elsewhere, not in this packet) is 1, each call increments it: steps 1 to 5 drive PA11 high, and step 6 drives it low through gpio_bits_reset on GPIOA mask 0x800 (PA11), resets this counter to 0, clears the armed flag and returns true. Units are calls (ticks), not time. Probably used by a caller that needs a short fixed pulse on PA11, which may be shared with the USB D- and CAN1 RX pins. The caller is not in this packet.
